wins.text: Q4 revenue grew 70% YoY to $1.407B — highest growth rate as a public company — exceeding the high end of prior guidance by over 900 basis points
U.S. commercial revenue grew 137% YoY and 28% sequentially to $507M in Q4; full year U.S. commercial revenue grew 109% YoY to $1.465B
Highest-ever TCV quarter at $4.3B, up 138% YoY, eclipsing the prior record set just last quarter by over $1.5B
Adjusted operating income of $798M in Q4 at a 57% margin, exceeding prior guidance by 500 bps; full year adjusted free cash flow of $2.27B at a 51% margin, up 82% YoY
Rule of 40 score reached 127% in Q4, up 46 points YoY and 13 points QoQ — 10th consecutive quarter of expansion; full year Rule of 40 at 106%

risks.text: International commercial revenue grew only 8% YoY and 2% for the full year, reflecting persistent weakness and slow AI adoption outside the U.S., particularly in Europe and Canada

Management acknowledged bandwidth constraints — U.S. demand is so intense that it limits Palantir's ability to pursue international opportunities, creating potential long-term geographic concentration risk
Expenses expected to increase in 2026 as Palantir continues investing in AIP and elite technical hiring, with full year adjusted expenses up 28% YoY in 2025
Government contracts often have termination-for-convenience clauses and short initial terms, limiting RPO visibility for the government segment
Heavy customer concentration risk: trailing 12-month revenue from top 20 customers at $94M per customer, with growth driven by deepening density rather than broad customer count expansion

guidance_items.detail: Q1 2026 revenue guided to $1.532B–$1.536B; full year 2026 revenue guided to $7.182B–$7.198B (midpoint $7.190B), representing 61% YoY growth — well above the ~30% growth guided at the start of 2025
U.S. commercial revenue guided to in excess of $3.144B for full year 2026, representing at least 115% growth
Q1 2026 adjusted income from operations guided to $870M–$874M; full year 2026 adjusted income from operations guided to $4.126B–$4.142B
Full year 2026 adjusted free cash flow guided to $3.925B–$4.125B; GAAP operating income and net income expected in each quarter of 2026; full year Rule of 40 guided to 118%
Strategic commercial contract revenue anticipated to be less than $7M in 2026 (less than 0.1% of revenue), down from $5.1M in Q1 2025 alone

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Whether Palantir is capturing an increasing share of customer budgets beyond the original scope of engagement (budget expansion / wallet share)
Potential for ShipOS / Warp Speed to expand into other defense reindustrialization verticals such as munitions, fighters, and drones
Whether the broader market's 'show-me' skepticism on enterprise AI ROI is affecting Palantir's commercial pipeline or customer hesitancy
